title: Tiny Taylor tour and rehearsing for King Oliver, early 1932
summary: Dupre untangles the sequence: rehearsals for King Oliver, a Frederick Brothers tour under Tiny Taylor's name in Texas and Oklahoma, then back to Wichita to prepare for King Oliver.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: When did you start rehearsing with King Oliver?
Oh, we started rehearsing round about January or February of '32. But then, Frederick Brothers sent Bronson's band out on the road to play some dates under
Phillips - 97
another name, named Tiny Taylor. Did I tell you about Tiny Taylor?
A singer.

A singer. He went down to Texas, and we went to Oklahoma, and we went to... Where did we go? I think it was Oklahoma and Texas. He had some dates booked, and he sent us out on them. Then, when we came back, that's when we started rehearsing with King Oliver. No, and then we had... Yeah, because the first date we went out with King was in Kansas. He sent us out with King in Kansas...
The Frederick Brothers sent you out with King Oliver in Kansas. And what month was that?
It must have been about February or March.
So you'd already been rehearsing with him.
We'd already been rehearsing, yeah, for... We were rehearsing for King's band.
But then you went out with Tiny Taylor.
Yeah.
And when you came back, you started working with King Oliver.
Under King Oliver's name.
Under his name?
Yeah.
Was he in the band at the time?
No, he wasn't with us.
Phillips - 98
So when you first started working under King Oliver's name was in February or March of '32?
It must have been about March, yeah.
So he wasn't in the band.
No, he wasn't in the band when we joined with Tiny.
Oh, you mean that first thing with Tiny Taylor was under King Oliver's name.
No, no, under Tiny Taylor's name.
Then, when you came back in February or March, about March, you said...

Yeah, that's when we... We'd already been rehearsing, and King had his numbers that we wanted to rehearse that he played. And we rehearsed those and got him down, what he played, his stuff. Then we went out on the gig. Frederick Brothers booked the band out into Kansas, some of those towns... I forget the name of the towns in Kansas. It was getting warm. It was getting warm, because where we played was an outdoors pavilion. It must have been around April, the latter part of April, or something like that. We went out with him. Then the next time we went out, that's when we went for good, because they sent us to Kansas City...
The first time you went out under King Oliver's name, he wasn't there.
Yeah.
Phillips - 99
He wasn't there or he was there?
He was!
The first time he went out in March... I misunderstood. I thought you said that you just went out under his name and he wasn't there.
No, no... Oh, yeah, we went out, but that was when we were down in Texas. That was around a little after Christmas.
I'm confused here. Just let me get this straight. You started out in Bronson's band until New Year's 1932.
Yeah, New Year's.
Then you went and rehearsed with King Oliver. Then you went out with Tiny Taylor...
Right after that.
Under whose name was that?
Tiny.
Under Tiny's name.
Yeah.
Then you came back...
We came back, then that's when we were getting ready for King.
You came back to which city again?
Wichita, Kansas.
You came back to Wichita, getting ready for King Oliver. So when did you finally go out and play...?
